name: Profile-shaped board (WP-200): an F1-only profile gets ONLY F1
description: The WP-200 acceptance case, frozen. A user who picked just «Formel 1» in onboarding has a profile with ONE rule — the F1 tournament entity — which projects to interests with an EXPLICIT, empty followBroadly (no sport-level rule ⇒ nothing is followed wholesale) plus that one tracked tournament. Before WP-200 this board was catalog-wide: the projection returned followBroadly:null, so the lens fell back to the nine-sport default AND the norwegian/favorite/importance blanket (rule 3) was a blank cheque — golf-norsk, cycling-norsk, football-vm-final and biathlon-fav ALL reached the board of an F1-only user. They are now dropped, because rule (3) is scoped to the sports the profile covers (followBroadly ∪ every tracked entity's sport = {f1} here). Inside f1 the blanket still works: f1-imp5 has no tracked-entity match at all and is admitted on importance alone, which is the difference between a sport SCOPE and an entity GATE (contrast chess/esports in vector 14). The follow stays precise all the same — f2-sprint is an f1-sport event whose haystack names no tracked entity and carries no blanket signal, so it drops. mustWatch is empty on purpose: a tournament entity defaults to notify:false (helpers.js normalizeEntity), so following the championship shapes the board without arming the bell.
